newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia tin price dips on active selling.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia tin price dips on active selling.

text.p: Malaysia's tin price fell two cents to 14.41 ringgit ($5.81) a kg after active selling by players despite a strong overnight on the London Metal Exchange (LME), said traders.
"It's a bit unusual but there was a lot selling, although the LME rose $80 yesterday (Tuesday)," said a trader in Malaysia.

Offers totalled 100 tonnes against bids of 89. Buyers were Europeans, Japanese and locals. Turnover fell to 90 tonnes from 121 on Tuesday. The market ended at a discount of $65 against the LME, compared to a premium of $25 previously.
